# What is fix?

## Dimas fix the bug that related to duplication

I pulled the github together from Dimas's and mine into the github copies. 
`https://github.com/Victoriasja18/eris`

## Precision Recall 

All the validations, including GFA (only with names) and FA (with location) can be found in `matrix.py` script.

### Validation for Simulated GFA
```{bash}
# uv run eris -i ../data/EC958_complete_genome.fasta -d ../data/IS_n.mmi -o ../progress/result/dimas_fa -m collapse --merge-synonyms
```

Validation after merging with min identity = 0.75
```{python}
import matrix as mt
import pandas as pd

# The simulated GFA was assembled from the chromosome only
gt = mt.read_truth(mt.GT_CHROMOSOME, exclude=["ISSen10"])
gfa = mt.read_report("../result/dimas_fix_sim/dimas_fix_sim_report.tsv")

summaries = []
for count_copies in (True, False):
    summary, detail = mt.precision_recall_gfa(gt, gfa, count_copies=count_copies)
    summaries.append(summary)

display(pd.DataFrame(summaries))

# IS where eris and the truth disagree (copies counted)
_, detail = mt.precision_recall_gfa(gt, gfa, count_copies=True)
detail[(detail["FP"] > 0) | (detail["FN"] > 0)]

```

Table comparison:

- Before: `new_merge_id` (my stitching fix, before merging adimascf's fix)
- After: `dimas_fix_sim` (after merging adimascf's fix)

| Run    | Copies         | TP | FP | FN | Precision | Recall | F1    |
|--------|----------------|----|----|----|-----------|--------|-------|
| Before | Counted Copies | 47 | 20 | 1  | 0.701     | 0.979  | 0.817 |
| After  | Counted Copies | 47 | 6  | 1  | 0.887     | 0.979  | 0.931 |
| Before | Only by name   | 31 | 1  | 1  | 0.969     | 0.969  | 0.969 |
| After  | Only by name   | 31 | 2  | 1  | 0.939     | 0.969  | 0.954 |

### Validation for Complete genome GFA (realfastq)

```{python}
# The simulated GFA was assembled from the chromosome only
gt_comp = mt.read_truth(mt.GT_COMPLETE, exclude=["ISSen10"])
gfa_comp = mt.read_report("../result/realfastq/realfastq_report.tsv")

summaries = []
for count_copies in (True, False):
    summary, detail = mt.precision_recall_gfa(gt_comp, gfa_comp, count_copies=count_copies)
    summaries.append(summary)

display(pd.DataFrame(summaries))

# IS where eris and the truth disagree (copies counted)
_, detail = mt.precision_recall_gfa(gt_comp, gfa_comp, count_copies=True)
detail[(detail["FP"] > 0) | (detail["FN"] > 0)]

```

### Validation for Complete genome 

```{python}
# The simulated GFA was assembled from the chromosome only
fa = mt.read_report("../result/dimas_fa/dimas_fa_report.tsv")

# IS where eris and the truth disagree (copies counted)
summary, detail = mt.precision_recall(gt_comp, fa, buffer=0)
display(pd.DataFrame([summary]))
detail[detail["result"] != "TP"][["contig", "start", "end", "name", "result", "fp_reason"]]

```
